name: discovery_checks_v1

DISCOVERY_ACCURACY_R2.meaning: A reported law is accurate when its R-squared on noise-free rows held back from the fit is at least this; below it the law is wrong. It defines 'wrong' and 'inaccurate' in every discovery benchmark.

defined_before_as: apedp_dyn/discovery_l2/vouching.py POWER = canonical TEMPORAL_RATE_CALIBRATION_POWER_MIN, a threshold for calibrating temporal rate models
LAST_CHECKS_MIN_POWER.meaning: The power the last checks must have against an error large enough to make a law wrong; with less, the law is withheld.

defined_before_as: apedp_dyn/discovery_l2/vouching.py LEVEL = canonical DIEBOLD_MARIANO_P_VALUE_THRESHOLD, a threshold for comparing forecasts
LAST_CHECKS_TEST_LEVEL.meaning: The family level at which the last checks' tests refuse a law; the second version runs two tests at half of it each.

what: Thresholds of the discovery routes' last checks and of their benchmarks, each named by what it means. Until 2026-11-23 the accuracy line was a bare literal in three files and the checks' level and power were borrowed from canonical-spec entries defined for other tests. The values are unchanged; only their names and their pin are new. Loaded by apedp_dyn/conf/discovery_checks.py, which checks this file's SHA-256. Not covered by the signed governance manifest until the trustees sign it.
